description: Paired faithful/unfaithful RAG answers over Brazilian health-insurance policy snippets. Every pair shares the same retrieved context; the unfaithful answer contains at least one claim the context does not support.

cases.name: carencia_emergencia

context.text: O plano Essencial cobre consultas de emergencia com carencia de 24 horas apos a assinatura do contrato. O limite anual de reembolso do plano Essencial e de R$ 50.000.
